sharedProps.name: data
sharedProps.description: The series. `null` / `NaN` are gaps, never zeros. The one required prop; each chart documents its own shape when it isn't a plain number array.

sharedProps.name: domain
sharedProps.description: Fix the value range instead of auto-fitting.

sharedProps.name: color
sharedProps.description: Mark color: any CSS color or a token (`"var(--mc-accent)"`). Semantic tokens keep their meaning.

sharedProps.name: title
sharedProps.description: Names the chart — rendered as an SVG `<title>`, so it becomes the accessible name and the native hover tooltip, not visible text on the page.

sharedProps.name: summary
sharedProps.description: Override the auto-generated accessible sentence, or pass `false` to drop it — with no `title`, that marks the chart decorative (hidden from assistive tech).

sharedProps.name: format
sharedProps.description: How numbers render in labels and summaries.

sharedProps.name: positive
sharedProps.description: Which direction is good, so color and arrows point the honest way (lower latency is `"down"`).

sharedProps.name: label
sharedProps.description: A short direct label next to the mark, in a reserved gutter — never an axis or legend.

sharedProps.name: dots
sharedProps.description: Which individual points to emphasize (e.g. `"minmax"` on a line).

sharedProps.name: width
sharedProps.description: Rendered width. Omit both dimensions to size from the container.

sharedProps.name: height
sharedProps.description: Rendered height.

sharedProps.name: className
sharedProps.description: Class on the chart root.

sharedProps.name: style
sharedProps.description: Inline style on the chart root (a common place to set width/height).

sharedProps.name: id
sharedProps.description: Opts into `<title>`/`<desc>` + `aria-labelledby` naming instead of the default `aria-label`.

sharedProps.name: locale
sharedProps.description: BCP-47 locale for number and date formatting (defaults to the runtime locale).

sharedProps.name: strings
sharedProps.description: Override the summary/label string templates for translation.

sharedProps.name: seriesStrings
sharedProps.description: Multi-series analog of `strings` — series/slot labels for charts that plot several series.

sharedProps.name: animate
sharedProps.description: Opt-in entrance motion when the chart mounts client-side — add `import "@microcharts/react/motion"` once. Inert on the server, on hydrated server HTML, and under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

sharedProps.name: live
sharedProps.description: Announce value changes through a polite live region as the data updates (default on), on the entries whose value can change without the reader touching the chart. Charts that stream a fast-moving number throttle their own announcements — EtaBar exposes the interval as `announceEvery`.

sharedProps.name: onActive
sharedProps.description: The active unit changed — the one under the pointer or the keyboard focus. `null` when the chart is cleared (pointer leaves, focus blurs, Escape). Payload is `MicroDatum` — `{ index, value, label?, formatted? }`, where `index` identifies the navigable unit, `value` is its primary encoded number (`null` for an empty unit), and `formatted` is the exact string the chart's own readout chip would show. Pair with `readout={false}` to render that value outside the chart.

sharedProps.name: onSelect
sharedProps.description: A unit was activated — click, tap, `Enter` or `Space`. On multi-unit pickers this pins the unit so it survives blur (`null` when cleared by re-selecting or `Escape`). On lean scalars there is only one unit, so the callback fires with no pinned state. Same `MicroDatum` payload as `onActive`.

sharedProps.name: selectedIndex
sharedProps.description: Controlled selected unit — an index into the chart's navigable units, or `null` for none. Pass it to own the selection; pair with `onSelect`.

sharedProps.name: defaultSelectedIndex
sharedProps.description: Uncontrolled initial selection. Ignored once `selectedIndex` is set. Use it to open a chart with one unit already pinned.

sharedProps.name: readout
sharedProps.description: Show the floating value chip that follows the pointer/focus (default `true`). `false` suppresses only the chip — the hover crosshair, keyboard roving, live-region announcements, and both callbacks keep working — so you can render `datum.formatted` in your own layout instead.
